topic: How do GEO vs LEO satellite orbits affect latency and coverage in hybrid networks for rural substation monitoring?
consensus_response: GEO satellites offer wide coverage with high latency, while LEO satellites provide low latency with frequent handovers. A hybrid approach balances latency and coverage. Beamforming, MIMO, and AI enhance performance but introduce complexity. Edge computing optimizes real-time data processing, improving rural substation monitoring.
reference_context: Satellite orbits impact latency and coverage, with GEO suitable for bulk data and LEO for real-time data, requiring beamforming and MIMO to mitigate interference and Doppler effects.
